summary: Junior DevSecOps Engineer with **1+ year of experience** running SaaS and customer production environments on **Microsoft Azure**. Hands-on with Terraform, Azure Services and Azure DevOps CI/CD. Delivered production migrations to Azure Managed Redis and Azure Container Apps, AKS cluster upgrades and cross-subscription moves, all with minimal downtime. Experienced in cloud security and DevSecOps, including **SOC 2 and ISO 27001** readiness, Wiz vulnerability management, container image scanning, RBAC and managed identities.

principles.title: Secure by default
principles.text: Managed identities over secrets, least-privilege RBAC and continuous image scanning.

principles.title: Everything as code
principles.text: If it runs in production, it lives in Terraform state and in a reviewed pipeline.

principles.title: Minimal downtime
principles.text: Dry runs, PDB planning and staged rollouts before anything touches production.

principles.title: Cost aware
principles.text: Automation that switches off what isn't needed, so the cloud bill matches real use.
